description: Lists the maimai DX songs and charts released recently, by release date, newest first: on each date the new songs, and the new charts added to songs released before, with the level and internal level (譜面定数) of each chart. Use it for "what is new" questions. Release dates are those of Japan.

days.description: Release dates from this many days before today (UTC). Default 30.

limit.description: Most songs to return, newest dates first, 1 to 200. Default 50.

server.description: Game server: jp, intl, usa or cn. Only the charts on that server, with its own level where it differs; a song is new on the date of its first chart there. Omitted: every chart of every server.

since.description: First release date to list, YYYY-MM-DD. Give since or days, not both.

name: list_recent_songs

dataAsOf.description: When the catalog was last updated

date.description: Release date, YYYY-MM-DD; a date after today is announced

newCharts.description: Songs released before that gained charts on this date (新譜面), with only those charts

sheetIds.description: IDs of the charts released on this date

sheets.description: The charts released on this date

difficulty.description: basic, advanced, expert, master, remaster, or the label of an utage chart: 【習】

internalLevel.description: Internal level (譜面定数) of the current version, which ratings are made of

type.description: dx (DX chart), std (standard chart), utage or utage2p (宴, joke charts)

version.description: Game version the chart was added in, on the server asked for

unlockRequired.description: Whether the song must be unlocked in the game before it can be played

newSongs.description: Songs whose first chart was released on this date (新曲)

sheetIds.description: IDs of the charts released on this date

sheets.description: The charts released on this date

difficulty.description: basic, advanced, expert, master, remaster, or the label of an utage chart: 【習】

internalLevel.description: Internal level (譜面定数) of the current version, which ratings are made of

type.description: dx (DX chart), std (standard chart), utage or utage2p (宴, joke charts)

version.description: Game version the chart was added in, on the server asked for

unlockRequired.description: Whether the song must be unlocked in the game before it can be played

server.description: Server of the charts, or null for every server

total.description: Songs released since then, before limit

truncated.description: Whether limit left out songs (of the oldest dates)

title: List recent songs
